text:
Sam: Heads-up — Kiln Labs offered us a 6-week early access window for their EdgeBlade v2 accelerator. NDA signed on our side (internal). They want benchmark results + perf telemetry. Who can own infra + bench integration? cc @Maria @Chris :megaphone:

Maria: I can own the bench harness. Need the disk image + SSH creds for their lab. Also what model sizes / memory targets should we prioritize?

Chris: I can own telemetry hooks (power traces + KV-cache spans). Do we have Kiln's telemetry schema? If not, we should ask for a sample payload and auth method.

Anya: Quick legal note — NDA allows internal evaluation only. No public publishing of benchmarks or marketing collateral without explicit partner sign-off. We'll need a review step for any external-facing numbers.

Sam: Good call Anya. For bench targets let's prioritize 16B and 70B variants. Context lengths: 4k for 16B, 32k for 70B. Primary metrics: latency (p50/p90/p99), throughput, memory, and power draw. Target: draft results by 2024-04-10 so product can prep embargoed summary.

Maria: Ack. I'll pin a harness in the infra repo: https://git.redwood/integration/kiln-edgeblade

Maria: Setup snippet I'll use to sanity-check nodes:
```
ssh kiln@edgeblade.test
sudo ./run_bench.sh --model redwood/70B-4k --seq 4096 --warm 200 --iter 1000
```

Chris: Telemetry envs I'll add to the harness:
```
export KILN_TELEM_ENDPOINT=https://telemetry.kiln/api/submit
export REDWOOD_TELEM_KEY=kv-xxxx
```
I'll also instrument KV cache latency spans and add power-sample hooks (per-step timestamps).

DevOps-Bot: artifact uploaded: kiln-edge-image-20240401.img (28.1G) to s3://redwood-kiln/artifacts/edgeblade/

Sam: Any blockers? We also need a simple publication guardrail: product drafts embargoed copy, we send to Kiln for approval before any external mention.

Maya: I'll draft the embargoed summary by 2024-04-05 and coordinate timing with Kiln lab ops. I'll also request any constraints on which figures are allowed to be shared.

Chris: Quick ask for Kiln: can you provide per-step power CSVs (timestamp, pwr_w) from the lab PMU? Otherwise we'll approximate via external meter.

Kiln-Rep: Hi all — we can deliver per-step power CSVs and SSH accounts next week. We'll also provide a small telemetry JSON schema and an API token for submission. NDA contact at kiln: legal@kiln.com.

Sam: Perfect. Let's sync Thu 10:00am PST. Agenda: bench plan, telemetry contract/schema, publication guardrails, access creds. :calendar:

Maria: Slot works for me.

Anya: I'll join for the NDA/policy portion.

Sam: Thanks everyone — please add any pre-reads to the repo and ping if you need help with access. :thumbsup:
